name: fsa-eleventy-poc
description: Deployment-isolated Eleventy PoC for FSA module templatization (Stage 1B). NOT a production build. Lives outside the deploy root so Vercel never auto-detects it.

scripts.verify: eleventy && for m in money-mindset-cash-flow emergency-funds-saving banking-basics credit-scores debt-strategy taxes-paychecks investing-fundamentals risk-insurance consumer-protection financial-master-plan; do if cmp -s _site/modules/$m.html ../../modules/$m.html; then echo "$m: BYTE-IDENTICAL"; else echo "$m: DIFFERS"; fi; done
